name: Value added tax on construction services - Law 157/2025
name_ar: ضريبة القيمة المضافة على خدمات المقاولات - القانون رقم 157 لسنة 2025
standard: Value Added Tax Law, amended by Law No. 157 of 2025; Ministry of Finance Decrees 417 and 418 of 2025
why_no_rules: The regime is resolved by document date in core (app.core.vat_regimes.data_eg and the VAT_CONSTR tax seed line), so a bill or invoice is priced correctly without a rule set. This document records what the platform applies.

regimes.basis: 14 percent on 36 percent of the contract value, for contracts signed before 2025-07-18 that were already being billed

source_note: Read in EY Tax News 2025-2316 on 2026-10-19. The scope of construction services is Decree 417 of 2025, effective 2025-10-24.
review_status: Provisional. Open question for an Egyptian tax adviser: whether an invoice issued between 2025-07-18 and 2025-10-24 at 14 percent on the full value may be corrected onto the transitional regime.
